name: @map-harness/spatial-decision
description: P3 spatial decision models: the versioned attribution (association/model-explanation/causal-effect), forecast (validation/fit/prediction with baselines, intervals, drift, and out-of-domain states), and constrained scenario optimization (comparison and allocation with capacity/cost/equity weights, infeasible candidates, and weight sensitivity) method contracts and computations. Attribution outputs never upgrade beyond their declared evidence conditions; forecasts always carry a simple baseline and a training cutoff; optimization never claims a global optimum.
